take: Per the Red Wings' announcement, Detroit activated forwards Marco Kasper and Mason Appleton from injured reserve. Kasper has played three games this season and scored once, and when he's on the ice the Red Wings control about 17 percentage points more of the quality chances (expected goals, a measure of shot quality) than when he sits. Appleton's numbers point the other way: Detroit's share of chances is about 8 points worse with him out there. Both bring Detroit, now 7-10-3, back to a fuller lineup.
